# Ubiquiti UniFi Pro Max 16 (USW-Pro-Max-16), 16-port managed switch

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `ubiquiti-usw-pro-max-16` |
| Category | purchased |
| Product | <https://store.ui.com/us/en/products/usw-pro-max-16> |
| Installation_guide | <https://dl.ui.com/qig/usw-pro-max-16> |

Non-PoE model: 4 x 2.5GbE, 12 x 1GbE, 2 x 10G SFP+, Layer 3, UniFi Network 8.1.127
or later. Half-width steel case; rack mounting needs the separate
UACC-Pro-Max-16-RM 1U kit (Ubiquiti store: "Requires add-on Rack Mount accessory").
Powered by the included external AC/DC adapter through USB-C (5 V, 5 A); the
adapter's mains plug type is not on the tech specs page.
Cooling is not stated on Ubiquiti's tech specs; retailers (Adorama) list it as
fanless. Confirm on the unit: the cabinet is an acoustic one.
Max 25 W, 85.3 BTU/hr; ambient -5 to 40 C, which the cabinet air must stay under.

## Interfaces

- provides `ethernet-2.5gbe-rj45` value 2.5GbE RJ45 count 4 (datasheet) — tech specs: 4 x 2.5 GbE RJ45 (2.5G/1G/100M/10M)
- provides `ethernet-1gbe-rj45` value 1GbE RJ45 count 12 (datasheet) — tech specs: 12 x 1 GbE RJ45
- provides `sfp-plus-port` value 10G SFP+ count 2 (datasheet) — tech specs: 2 x 10G SFP+ (10G/1G)
- requires `ac-power` load 25 W (datasheet) — tech specs max power; the included adapter's efficiency is not stated, so the wall draw is somewhat higher
- requires `switch-rack-kit` value UACC-Pro-Max-16-RM count 1 (datasheet) — only when rack mounted; desktop and wall mounting need no kit
